title: Draft
description: The drafting stage's artifact of record (P7, B31): every section and slot the approved plan owes, each with drafted prose or a named reason it has none. Written complete at prepass (in_progress — a run killed before its first model call still names every slot owed) and finalized at assembly. P9's revision lane increments revision_n; P9 write-back consumes the per-slot answers.

plan_sha256.description: sha256 of plan.frozen.json — binds this draft to the Gate-2-approved plan (T6 analog). A re-planned pursuit voids the draft by mismatch, not by convention.

revision_n.description: 0 at P7. The P9 revision lane increments it (revise-never-restart).

status.description: in_progress = the prepass skeleton; complete = assembly finished (pended sections may remain — completeness of the record, not of the content).

warnings.description: Run-level drop-and-report records (B31): every wire deviation the parser corrected, named. Nothing is dropped silently.

section_type.description: Deterministic code-assigned type (B31: the 16-value KB ingest vocabulary + 'other'). Deliberately a bare string, not an enum — the vocabulary's source of truth is A2's; pinning it here would force schema churn there. Mirrors run-log target.section_type; 13 metrics slice on it.

status.description: drafted = prose landed; pending = owed but not produced (reason names why — parse failure, awaiting disposition, killed run); omitted = human-approved omission (B24); skipped_non_prose = no authored-prose lane at P7 (B28(4)).

reason.description: Why a non-drafted section has no prose. Required by code on every pending/omitted/skipped section.

prose.description: Path B: the section's drafted text. Absent on Path A (per-slot answers carry the text). No control characters except TAB/LF/CR (P26a, P2-29b): the wire refuses them on entry, and this pattern is the last line at write_artifact — python-docx refuses them at the exit door.

answers.description: Path A: one entry per slot the section answers, in plan slot order. The write-back grain (P9).

ref_id.description: The buyer's own numbering, carried verbatim from the slot.

prose.description: No control characters except TAB/LF/CR (P2-29b) — see the section-level prose.

reason.description: Named reason for every non-drafted status.

kb_ids.description: This answer's surviving citations — model-claimed ids intersected by code against the cards actually opened for this section (B21(4) carried to drafting). Union across answers = the section's cards_cited.

proposed_approach.description: Code-scanned presence of the literal [proposed approach] flag in prose — never model-claimed.

omission_stated.description: True when the code-composed honest-omission line is present (omit_approved + state_if_not_offered constraint flag; v1 lesson — the model structurally cannot author refusals).

cards_cited.description: Section-level citation union, plan kb_hits order. Mirrors the run-log step:'cite' kb_retrieval line — the WP9 edit_survival join input.

canonical.description: One entry per canonical-block card the plan selected for this section (B12): was its body reproduced near-verbatim (whitespace-normalized containment)?

verified.description: False = recorded finding, card still cited; P8's validation stack formalizes enforcement.

proposed_approach.description: Any [proposed approach] flag present in this section's prose (code-scanned).
